title: agent-failure-reflection-gate howto
desc: Implementation mechanics for the agent-failure-reflection-gate: module location, resolution order, record-check, self-test, env overrides. Read agent-failure-reflection-gate first for the design/spec; this is the how.
steps: MODULE LOCATION: tools/wkharness-guards-agent-failure-reflection.ps1, dot-sourced from wkharness-guards.ps1 immediately BEFORE tools/wkharness-guards-agent.ps1 (the latter's Agent-dispatch wiring calls Get-WkAgentFailureGateVerdict, defined in the former; load order matters).

DETECTION MECHANICS: scan the newest subagents/agent-*.jsonl file's last assistant message for failure markers (could not complete, unable to complete, failed to, gave up, I cannot, permission denied, blocked by clean-baseline/busy-fleet/write-freeze) OR a leaf-redelegation tell (I have dispatched/launched an agent -- a leaf claiming it delegated means it did NOT do the work itself) OR any tool_result rc field != 0.

RESOLUTION (rewritten 2026-07-03, see agent-failure-reflection-gate-ref for the bug this fixed): Get-WkAfgAllReflectionCandidates builds ONE table of (Key, SkillId) pairs from the hardcoded aliases (haiku/sonnet/codex|gpt/codex-mini|gpt-mini/gemini|flash/opus) PLUS every real installed reflection skill own filename-derived key. Get-WkAfgReflectionSkillId then checks whether the RAW model string (a real transcript records the FULL id, e.g. claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, never a short alias) CONTAINS a candidate Key as a substring, picking the LONGEST matching Key as most specific -- this single reversed-containment rule replaces the old two-step map-then-loose-search design and also disambiguates gemini-pro vs agy-gemini-pro without a separate starts-with rule. If nothing matches, suggest the canonical <model>-reflection id and block with NeedsCreate=true -- the VERY NEXT verdict check then re-resolves once the skill exists and falls into the RECORD check below (no separate read-only closure state; that two-state design was tried and found unreachable in practice, see agent-failure-reflection-gate-ref).

RECORD CHECK (Test-WkRecentReflectionEdit): satisfied by EITHER a session-log line matching skill edit <id> --add-step OR a line matching skill contribute plus --id <id> -- unified so a freshly created skill with good --steps content does not need a redundant follow-up edit.

SELF-TEST: a standalone self-test lives at the bottom of the module file, guarded by checking MyInvocation.InvocationName so it never runs during normal dot-sourcing (only when the file is executed directly). Covers 8 scenarios: no-failure-allow, mapped-skill-needs-record, mapped-skill-recorded-allow, rc-nonzero-failure, leaf-redelegation-failure, unmapped-model-needs-create, unmapped-model-created-but-unrecorded, unmapped-model-recorded-via-contribute-allow. Run with: powershell -NoProfile -File tools/wkharness-guards-agent-failure-reflection.ps1 (direct execution, not dot-sourced).

TEST ENV OVERRIDES (used by the self-test and available for any live debugging): WKHARNESS_TEST_AGENTFAIL_JSONL points Get-WkNewestAgentFailureJsonl at a fixture file instead of scanning subagents/; WKHARNESS_TEST_REC_JSONL points the session-log check at a fixture instead of the real active session; WKHARNESS_TEST_SKILL_BASES (newline-separated paths) points the skill-cache scan at fixture directories instead of the real skill caches.
